skill.name: pydeseq2
skill.description: Guides differential expression analysis of bulk RNA-seq counts with PyDESeq2, including design formulas, Wald tests, FDR correction, result export, and visualization.
skill.summary: Build and interpret reproducible PyDESeq2 workflows for bulk RNA-seq differential expression.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All 74 static findings are false positives involving Markdown, expected output writes, documentation links, or sample-filtering guidance. However, the workflow recommends pickle.load without a trust warning, which can execute malicious payloads. No prompt injection, network requests, credential access, or covert command execution was found.

remediation.issue: The workflow presents pickle.load as a general input method without warning that deserialization can execute code.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer CSV, TSV, or H5AD inputs. If pickle remains documented, require trusted provenance and add an explicit arbitrary-code-execution warning.

content.value_statement: Bulk RNA-seq comparisons require careful data alignment, model design, and multiple-testing correction. This skill guides PyDESeq2 workflows from count preparation through differential expression results and plots.
actual_capabilities: Loads and aligns count matrices with sample metadata from CSV, TSV, or AnnData inputs.
Filters low-count genes and samples with missing condition metadata.
Builds single-factor, multi-factor, covariate, and interaction design formulas.
Runs PyDESeq2 fitting, Wald tests, independent filtering, and Benjamini-Hochberg correction.
Applies log fold-change shrinkage for ranking and visualization.
Exports result tables, fitted datasets, volcano plots, and MA plots.
limitations: Supports bulk RNA-seq count data, not normalized expression values or single-cell differential expression.
Requires PyDESeq2 and compatible Python scientific packages to run the provided workflow.
Cannot determine whether a design is biologically valid or sufficiently powered without experimental context.
Pickle files must come from trusted sources because deserialization can execute embedded code.

use_cases.title: Compare treatment and control samples
use_cases.description: Prepare a two-group analysis with filtered counts, an explicit contrast, adjusted p-values, and ranked genes.

use_cases.title: Control for batch effects
use_cases.description: Construct a multi-factor design that estimates condition effects while accounting for batch or continuous covariates.

use_cases.title: Automate repeatable RNA-seq analyses
use_cases.description: Use the command-line script to process datasets and export tables, fitted objects, volcano plots, and MA plots.

prompt_templates.title: Run a basic comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my counts file at [counts path] and metadata at [metadata path]. Compare [treated] against [control] using the [condition] column.

prompt_templates.title: Check and prepare inputs
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the count matrix and metadata at [paths]. Verify orientation, sample alignment, non-negative integer counts, missing values, and low-count filtering.

prompt_templates.title: Model batch-adjusted effects
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PyDESeq2 workflow for design [~batch + condition] and contrast [condition, treated, control]. Explain assumptions, diagnostics, and adjusted result interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a multi-contrast analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an advanced PyDESeq2 analysis for [factors and levels]. Include interactions, multiple contrasts, shrinkage strategy, quality checks, exports, and reproducibility notes.

output_examples.input: Compare treated and control samples while adjusting for sequencing batch.
output: Recommended design: batch followed by condition.
Primary contrast: treated versus control within the condition factor.
Report adjusted p-values, effect sizes, Cook distance handling, and sample alignment checks.

output_examples.input: Summarize significant genes from a completed PyDESeq2 result table.
output_examples.output: The summary reports tested genes, adjusted-significance counts, upregulated and downregulated totals, and top genes ranked by adjusted p-value.

output_examples.input: Create visualization guidance for differential expression results.
output_examples.output: Use shrunk fold changes for volcano and MA plots, label adjusted significance clearly, and retain unshrunken test statistics for inference.

best_practices: Confirm that count columns and metadata rows identify the same samples before fitting.
Use raw non-negative integer counts, filter weak genes, and document every filtering threshold.
Specify contrasts explicitly and interpret adjusted p-values alongside effect sizes and diagnostics.
anti_patterns: Do not use normalized, transformed, or fractional expression values as DESeq2 count input.
Do not remove confounded variables without explaining how the design and biological question change.
Do not load pickle files from untrusted or unknown sources.

faq.question: What inputs does the skill expect?
faq.answer: It expects a samples-by-genes matrix of non-negative integer counts and matching sample metadata with experimental factors.

faq.question: Can the workflow account for batch effects?
faq.answer: Yes. Include batch before the variable of interest in a multi-factor design, provided the variables are not fully confounded.

faq.question: Does this skill support single-cell RNA-seq?
faq.answer: No. The documented methods target bulk RNA-seq counts and do not provide a validated single-cell differential expression workflow.

faq.question: Why might the count matrix need transposition?
faq.answer: Many files store genes as rows and samples as columns, while PyDESeq2 expects samples as rows and genes as columns.

faq.question: How should significance be interpreted?
faq.answer: Use adjusted p-values for false-discovery control and review effect sizes, dispersion, sample balance, and model assumptions before biological interpretation.

faq.question: Is it safe to load saved pickle files?
faq.answer: Only load pickle files from trusted sources. Pickle deserialization can execute embedded code, so safer formats are preferred for shared data.
